TAT-8 provides historical optical-system context; split a teaching route into spans below a maximum, with internal units equal to span count minus one, excluding shore terminals. Map each quantity or event to an interface, then construct this synthetic input table: Synthetic6200 km route, maximum span50 km; compare60 km with uniform placement.
